fields.description: Save format marker: FUN_08003410 always writes constant value 5 here after the magic.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003410 sets local_c=5 and writes EEPROM byte 4 via FUN_08012ec0(&local_c,4,1); baseline logical byte 4 = 0x05.
fields.name: save_format_marker

fields.description: First two bytes of the 19-byte payload window; preserved under the payload XOR checksum. No dedicated writer in decomp.
fields.evidence: Bytes lie in EEPROM [6,0x19) window read by FUN_08013040(auStack_20,6,0x13) and covered by the FUN_080034ec XOR checksum stored at byte 5 in FUN_08003410; baseline logical bytes [6,8) = ff 03.
fields.name: payload_head

fields.description: Three zero bytes inside the checksummed payload window; preserved under the payload XOR checksum.
fields.evidence: Bytes lie in EEPROM [6,0x19) window read by FUN_08013040(auStack_20,6,0x13) and covered by the FUN_080034ec XOR checksum stored at byte 5 in FUN_08003410; baseline logical bytes [8,11) = 00 00 00.
fields.name: payload_zeroes

fields.description: Eleven-byte block inside the checksummed payload window (baseline fill 0x42); preserved under the payload XOR checksum. No dedicated writer in decomp.
fields.evidence: Bytes lie in EEPROM [6,0x19) window read by FUN_08013040(auStack_20,6,0x13) and covered by the FUN_080034ec XOR checksum stored at byte 5 in FUN_08003410; baseline logical bytes [11,22) are eleven 0x42 bytes.
fields.name: payload_block

fields.description: Progress high-water mark: only ever raised to a new maximum (or set to 7 on reset).
fields.evidence: FUN_080033c8 writes RAM mirror *DAT_0803415c to EEPROM byte 0x16 via FUN_08012ec0(local_8,0x16,1); called from FUN_0803410c monotonic-max update and FUN_0803418c (writes 7); baseline logical byte 0x16 = 0x07.
fields.name: progress_highwater

fields.description: Spare byte inside the checksummed payload window between the two progress bytes; preserved under the payload XOR checksum.
fields.evidence: Byte lies in EEPROM [6,0x19) window read by FUN_08013040(auStack_20,6,0x13) and covered by the FUN_080034ec XOR checksum stored at byte 5 in FUN_08003410; baseline logical byte 23 = 0xff.
fields.name: payload_spare

fields.description: Companion progress value written together with progress_highwater on every save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080033f8 writes *DAT_08034160 to EEPROM byte 0x18 via FUN_08012ec0(local_8,0x18,1); also written as 6 by FUN_0803418c and FUN_080341c4; baseline logical byte 0x18 = 0x06.
fields.name: progress_companion

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'dino' save magic at start of EEPROM (logical rev8 domain)
